items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: When I was with Louis Armstrong, we met him in Galveston... I want you to play trombone for me... So we go down the showboat and got a couple of weeks... So we stayed there three months.

ctx.x: Well, as you grew on in years, did you hear any more music?

Oh yeah, I, in spite of me hearing this music, I used to say, the second line just like the rest of the kids. We used to try sometime way away from home, you know, out of the neighborhood. I remember I, I think it was about the 30th of May and some friends of mine and I, we, we came all the way down to French Bar Town and the boys got behind us and ran us all the way to the podgers and ramparts, you know. And so I always did love music. I used to do a lot of whistling. I still do. And so, but I didn't have no…
Where was he from? He's from New Orleans.

items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: He was Louis Hot Five, and things like that.

ctx.x: Now how did you produce your vibrato back in the early days?

Well, to be truthful about the vibrato, I didn't pay any attention to the vibrato. You see, we'll just take Dutre for instance. Dutre and Zoo Robin was smooth. There was no one who played them shelly parts. And as you've heard Dutre when he played the jazz solos, his was a bit different than Roy. Roy would take a pair or something, you know, and put it over the bellies and it was rough, you know, gut bucket I'd say. Yeah. Now Roy, I'd come to Ory again. Ory was rough too. Yeah. But between the two, Ory couldn't…
He's a much slicker character. Yeah, yeah, yeah.

items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: INTERVIEWER: So you were talking about when you joined Louis Armstrong. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Louis came back. By the time Louis came back I had been studying... When I joined Louis, yeah. Louis came back. He was on his way to California to play at Sebastons.

ctx.x: So you were talking about when you joined Louis Armstrong.
Yeah, Louis came back. By the time Louis came back I had been studying on the Roy and Dutre. First one, first one I could catch. That was it.
Wait a minute. Okay, it's going now. Can you tell about when you joined Louis?
